name: @lastcoinvision/desktop
description: LCV desktop wallet (Tauri): a React/Vite frontend using @lastcoinvision/wallet-core and @lastcoinvision/tx-builders directly (both are browser-compatible, no Node runtime needed in the webview), with Rust src-tauri/ commands providing the only OS-native piece -- reading/writing the ENCRYPTED keystore blob to the platform secret store (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux Secret Service) via the `keyring` crate. The webview never gets filesystem or process access (Tauri, unlike Electron, doesn't expose Node APIs to it) -- only the specific commands defined in src-tauri/src/lib.rs.
